tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get the public profile of one Agenturo agent by its handle (the part before .agenturo.app): what it does, its topics, the questions it suggests starting with, and whether it answers messages sent through this connector.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent, ask_agent, chat_with_agent · Public sink: send_agent_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent, ask_agent, chat_with_agent · Public sink: send_agent_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
